# aggregate.collect_sidecar_outputs { #healpyxel.aggregate.collect_sidecar_outputs }

```python
aggregate.collect_sidecar_outputs(input_parquet, output_dir, read_stats=False)
```

Scan ``output_dir`` for sidecar parquet files matching the input stem.

Searches the output directory for sidecar files that belong to the given
input parquet file. Validates via ``.meta.json`` metadata when available,
falling back to filename pattern matching.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type   | Description                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| input_parquet | Path   | Path to the original input parquet file. Used for stem matching and source_file validation.                      | _required_ |
| output_dir    | Path   | Directory containing sidecar parquet files.                                                                      | _required_ |
| read_stats    | bool   | If True, read each sidecar to compute row counts and unique HEALPix counts. Slower but provides richer metadata. | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                |
|--------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame with columns: ``file``, ``coalesced``, ``mode``, ``nside``, ``order``, ``n_rows``, ``n_unique_healpix``, and optionally ``derived_from_parent``. |
